scope: B point/cursor driver over the C0 Row read boundary through private source/view traits. The driver opens each operation itself on the view it judges with (and, for a cursor, on the table stored at open). Runtime cases use a test-only literal source (independent RowLeaf/XRW1 cells, logical Status/Missing-before answers, literal target values) and a literal view/credit counter and table counter. In the double's C role the cells are wrapped by the production encode_page and read with the production tree/row codecs; expected values are literals. No RowReadOperation, Plan4Target, pin, snapshot, CallerCredit, RowCopyObservation, MissingRowEvidence, ACK or READY is created; the live entries are compile-checked only because the C0 bodies return Unsupported.
